promptTemplate:
你是一名资深数据工程师。以下报表 SQL 统计"每个客户的订单总额"，但财务发现金额被成倍放大。请找出并修复：

```sql
-- customers(id, name)
-- orders(id, customer_id, amount)
-- payments(id, order_id, paid_amount)  一个订单可有多笔支付
SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.amount) AS total
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;
```

输出要求：
1. 结论（有 bug / 无 bug）
2. 根因分析（1-3 句，解释 JOIN 扇出/fan-out）
3. 修复后的完整 SQL（包裹在 ```sql 代码块中，结果仍为每客户一行）
sourceCode:
SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.amount) AS total
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

fixture.schema: CREATE TABLE customers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, amount REAL); CREATE TABLE payments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, paid_amount REAL);
fixture.seed: INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1,'Alice'),(2,'Bob'); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1,1,100.0),(2,1,50.0),(3,2,30.0); INSERT INTO payments VALUES (1,1,60.0),(2,1,40.0),(3,2,50.0);

requirements.referenceSolution: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.amount) AS total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

promptTemplate:
你是一名资深数据工程师。以下查询"找出没有下过单的客户"在某天突然返回空结果（此前一直正常），排查发现 orders.customer_id 列新出现了 NULL 值。请找出并修复：

```sql
-- customers(id, name)
-- orders(id, customer_id)  customer_id 可能为 NULL（匿名订单）
SELECT *
FROM customers
WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders);
```

输出要求：
1. 结论（有 bug / 无 bug）
2. 根因分析（1-3 句，解释 NOT IN 遇到 NULL 的三值逻辑）
3. 修复后的完整 SQL（包裹在 ```sql 代码块中）

fixture.schema: CREATE TABLE customers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER);
fixture.seed: INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1,'Alice'),(2,'Bob'),(3,'Carol'); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1,1),(2,NULL);

requirements.referenceSolution: SELECT * FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id);

promptTemplate:
你是一名资深数据工程师。请编写 SQL 实现 Top-N 查询：

```sql
-- employees(id, name, dept, salary)
-- 要求：查询每个部门薪资最高的前 3 名员工
-- 输出列：dept, name, salary
-- 并列薪资都算入（例如并列第 3 的都输出）
```

输出要求：
1. 思路说明（1-3 句，说明窗口函数选择：RANK/DENSE_RANK/ROW_NUMBER 的差异）
2. 完整 SQL（包裹在 ```sql 代码块中）
sourceCode:
-- employees(id, name, dept, salary)
-- 每个部门薪资前 3 的员工（含并列）

requirements.initialCode:
-- employees(id, name, dept, salary)
-- 每个部门薪资前 3 的员工（含并列）

fixture.schema: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, dept TEXT, salary INTEGER);

requirements.referenceSolution: SELECT dept, name, salary FROM (SELECT dept, name, salary, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY salary DESC) AS r FROM employees) WHERE r <= 3 ORDER BY dept, salary DESC, name;
